task: Task 7 - QA split run and batch persistence
assertions: QaSplitRun and QaSplitBatch are registered in Base.metadata.
Run foreign keys reference import jobs, documents, task runs, model configs, and model providers.
Batch foreign keys reference its run and an optional persisted parent batch.
The unique constraint on run_id and batch_index rejects duplicate batch paths.
chunk_indexes rejects empty or duplicate values.
result_payload rejects prompt, api_key, and content keys.
The migration conditionally creates run and batch tables.
The migration conditionally adds model_config timeout columns and ModelCallLog batch observability columns.
The migration upgrade and downgrade preserve pre-existing model config and model call log rows in the SQLite migration contract.
